rules.driver: main_phase: if (arvalid) choose src in 0..2; pre-drive check and native E03
rules.monitor: main_phase_audit.py + sv_audit.py + canonical E03_SRC + independent protocol/random sample audit

rules.driver: main_phase: if (arvalid) choose arresp 0 or 3; pre-drive check and native E04
rules.monitor: main_phase_audit.py + sv_audit.py + canonical E04_ARRESP + independent protocol/random sample audit

rules.driver: When no AR lane is ready use arvalid=0, src=3. A queued or fixed-source generator waits for the selected lane.
rules.monitor: main_phase_audit.py + sv_audit.py + canonical E05_ZERO_READY + independent sampled-pin/solver and queue audit
rules.validation: Full queue blocking, same-cycle reuse and illegal valid with all ready bits clear

rules.driver: main_phase: for every bank/half, if req and both grants select it, assign busy=1; else chosen legal background
rules.monitor: main_phase_audit.py + sv_audit.py + canonical 8 E06 instances + independent audit of all 16 half bins
rules.validation: all 8 banks x 2 halves legal and injected violation; partial grants

rules.trigger: src < 3 -> arready[src] == 1 in every non-reset sample, including arvalid=0
rules.driver: main_phase chooses a ready source or uses src=3 with arvalid=0. Queued requests keep their original source.
rules.monitor: main_phase_driver + native E07 + independent sampled-interface audit
rules.validation: All sources, full-buffer idle src=3, idle blocked source with another lane ready

rules.driver: main_phase sets ar_rd_gnt[b]=0 when req[b]=0, else permits accept or denial. Legacy generation uses explicit grant ownership.
rules.monitor: main_phase_driver + native E08 + independent sampled-interface audit
rules.validation: Requested-bank grants and non-requested-bank grant violations including rw_rd_gnt=0

rules.trigger: MEM payload on issue edge N + 4 actual positive edges
rules.driver: main_phase: if (mem_due) mem_rdata=due_data and pc_err=due_error; else directed/random idle data
rules.monitor: main_phase_audit.py + sv_audit.py + independent Python calendar/FIFO + native capture model

rules.trigger: accepted request -> issue -> MEM -> source-ordered R; RRESP is 3 for ARRESP=3, otherwise 2 for captured PC_ERR=1, otherwise 0
rules.driver: main_phase_driver.svh; random: fresh 128-bit future payload per successful ISSUE; protocol: request token
rules.monitor: main_phase_audit.py + sv_audit.py + independent Python source FIFO/issue calendar + native SVA
rules.validation: duplicate IDs/addresses, mixed sources, incorrect RID, and all saved ARRESP/captured PC_ERR combinations

rules.trigger: literal clocks; reset cancels outstanding environment work
rules.driver: main_phase drives in the posedge time slot after DUT updates; explicit low/high/pause durations; one reset bootstrap edge
rules.monitor: main_phase_audit.py + sv_audit.py + fixed-input audit + cancellation conservation
rules.validation: reset while clock stopped; pending queue and in-flight reset; no hidden clocks

rules.trigger: normal sampled inputs known; clk/rst known always
rules.driver: main_phase_driver.svh; static width/range checks; 4-state preservation and runtime known-value check
rules.monitor: main_phase_audit.py + sv_audit.py + ENV_X_INPUT/STATUS + independent sample audit
rules.validation: numeric limits; reset X/Z preservation; active X/Z rejected

rules.trigger: each port has exactly one owner; fixed inputs immutable
rules.driver: TC if blocks own final values; driver validates then copies once; no hidden fixup
rules.monitor: main_phase_audit.py + sv_audit.py + random solver values equal all sampled inputs; protocol all-timestamp fixed audit
rules.validation: duplicate owner/missing lane/unsupported mode/source drift rejected

rules.trigger: requests complete/cancel or explicitly remain pending; bounded wait
rules.driver: Legacy protocol mode only; main_phase uses literal per-edge attempts with no automatic AR retry
rules.validation: send window; queue limit; timeout; pending tail; reset cancellation

rules.trigger: output correctness remains a DUT responsibility
rules.reads: all public ports and independent reference history
rules.driver: main_phase_driver.svh; never repair DUT outputs or force inputs to satisfy DUT assertions
rules.monitor: Current port SVA and reference model, plus independent sampled transaction checks
rules.validation: legacy regressions; RID injection; same-cycle capacity; per-XAU ordering; A_R_READY under backpressure and illegal unready R injected into checker; registered pending recurrence and clock-edge waveform checks
